Run only /usr/bin/sha256sum /root/holy127-transfer-inbox-runpath-v2/holy127-bootstrap-86bfdfe.py /root/holy127-transfer-inbox-runpath-v2/holy127-payload-86bfdfe.tar and require the two outputs, in order, to equal the bootstrap and payload hashes in this packet.
